mechanism: The 10 U.S.C. 2922a purchase-approval gate on the Eielson micro-reactor

sources.story_title: NEWS TRIGGER — Air Force asks for public input on proposed Eielson microreactor site. Comments to Eielson Public Affairs close Sept. 30.

sources.outlet: U.S. House Office of the Law Revision Counsel
sources.story_title: CHOKEPOINT — 10 U.S.C. 2922a, contracts for energy or fuel for military installations. Subsection (b): a contract may be made only after approval by the Secretary of Defense.
LAYER 1 — 32 CFR 989.15, Air Force EIAP. FONSI approval routed to the Environmental Protection Committee at a MAJCOM-determined level.
LAYER 2 — Executive Order 11990, Protection of Wetlands, Sec. 2(a). No new construction in wetlands absent a two-prong agency-head finding.

sources.outlet: SEC EDGAR — Oklo Inc. FY2025 Form 10-K (CIK 0001849056), filed 2026-03-17
sources.story_title: LAYER 4 — the developer's own filing: 'tentatively selected' and 'this has not been finalized.' Settles that no power purchase agreement is executed.
Supporting — 32 CFR 989.14(g), Finding of No Practicable Alternative submitted to the MAJCOM Environmental Planning Function.
